I own the land, and I have a bigger farm, so I will put some fertilizer here, but not heavy, and I will use manure from around the home too because that is what I know and what I have seen work. I will keep my local seed because I trust what I have used before, I will not irrigate because I farm with the rains, and I will hire a few hands when work is too much for my family alone.
